import 'package:camera_dart/camera_dart.dart';
Future<void> main() async { CameraControl.ensureInitialized(); if (CameraBackendRegistry.instance.selected.name != 'ffi') { throw StateError('native camera backend did not load'); } final cameras = await CameraControl.enumerate(); print('FFI loaded; enumerated ${cameras.length} camera devices'); await CameraBackendRegistry.instance.selected.dispose(); }
